spec: wiki Methods/'Method - Generative PC predictor plan', revision 2 (2026-10-13)

decisions_user.objective: predictive: k in {1,2,3} seen views per batch, loss/energy on all 4
decisions_user.precision: unit hidden precision in main arms; one d10 PC zero-start arm at hidden precision 9 (seed 0)
decisions_user.seeds: stage 1 = seed 0 of every arm; stage 2 = seeds 1,2 after the stage-1 report

decisions_after_review.c_selection: full 4000-step schedule stopped at 800 steps, val k=1 nmse at T=400, 90/10 train split, seed 0; diverged/exploded excluded; edge winners flagged not re-tuned
decisions_after_review.c_inheritance: width-control and precision arms use the c of their parent arm (same rule/depth/start)
decisions_after_review.divergence: non-finite step -> keep last finite weights, retry once at c/2 (recorded c_used); second failure or exploded energy -> .diverged.json, no result row
decisions_after_review.width_control: d3 at width 256 (PC and BP, seed 0)
decisions_after_review.diagnostics: tau-only, shuffled-s, copy-mean, per-level energy shares, relative last s-step, at T=400 and T=2000

questions.Q1: does generative PC prediction error fall with depth (d10 vs d3), at T=400 and settled
questions.Q2: PC vs BP auto-decoder on the identical network, per depth
questions.Q3: amortised (Fujita) vs zero start, per rule and depth
questions.Q4: robustness: absolute corrupted-input nmse, and its ratio to clean, vs the BP set predictor
